purpose: Make SATA legible over time through transparent reserve, liquidity, authority, and roadmap updates.

longTermTreasuryTarget.framing: Help speculative token traders learn to think in sats, reserves, custody, and proof over time; do not frame this as a guaranteed conversion, redemption path, price target, or market-support promise.

founder.name: Jean Bilong
founder.disclosure: SATA is an independent personal project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the founder's employer, clients, schools, or other organizations.

bio: Bitcoin-aligned community token on Solana. Mint/freeze authority revoked. Public liquidity and BTC reserve reports. Proof over promises. No redemption or price guarantee.
websiteStatus: Temporary transparency and launch-app surface while the dedicated official SATA website is being built.
allowedClaimsRequireCurrentReport: SATA mint exists on Solana mainnet
Raydium Burn & Earn LP lock is verified for the reported locked amount
owner unlocked LP remains removable when disclosed by the report
Bitcoin reserve balance is verified when reported
Bitcoin reserve address proof is verified only when the report proofValidation.ok field is true
prohibitedClaims: all liquidity locked when owner unlocked LP exists
GMGN support without current manual buy/sell route verification
requiredCaveats: The BTC reserve is not a redemption promise or guaranteed price floor.
Unlocked LP remains removable unless separately locked and verified.
SATA can be volatile and liquidity can be thin.
